anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet the capacitor C1, connected between the Display_Power_Switch rail and GND (in parallel with C2), is drawn with the value '0.1uF/16V'.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists C1 in the group of EPD capacitors that must match the Pervasive Displays default value of 1 uF / 25 V (the G1-specific 1 uF / 6.3 V value is placed on C2). C1 should therefore be 1 uF / 25 V, not 0.1 uF / 16 V.

evidence.quote: C1 0.1uF/16V (EPD_Driver.kicad_sch, page 3, right of the Display_Power_Switch label, next to C2 1uF/6.3V)
| C2 default: 1 uF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 uF/25 V | Matches default |

anomalies.impact: The display-power/booster input node is decoupled with one tenth of the intended capacitance and a lower voltage rating than the PDI reference calls out; the EPD supply rail will have poorer decoupling/ripple performance than the intended design (and reduced margin if the node ever exceeds 16 V).

parsed.summary: The design largely matches the specification, but the EPD driver sheet builds C1 as 0.1 uF / 16 V, whereas the specification explicitly places C1 in the group of PDI-matching display capacitors that must be 1 uF / 25 V, so the display-booster input decoupling deviates from the intended design.
